To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the more ADHD symptoms adolescents show, the higher their addictive social media use is; 2) the more ADHD adolescents show, the more they tend to have a past negative and a present fatalistic orientation; 3) the more ADHD they show, the more future-oriented they tend to be.
ADHD symptoms and past and present fatalistic orientations are positively related to addictive Facebook use, and future orientation is negatively related to addictive Facebook Use
